messages:
maria_support: Hey team, customer on acct-ACME reports SSE/chat stream truncates mid-response ~35-70s in, client reconnects and sees partial tokens. They hit it from a browser (Chrome) going through Cloudflare (proxied) -> ALB -> nginx -> app.

customer_acct: Repro steps I used: open EventSource('/v1/stream?model=redwood-7b'), after ~45s the stream stops, console shows net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET and last event is partial text. Happens reliably.

dan_engineer: Thanks — can you paste the curl + response headers and any upstream/nginx error lines? Also is ALB idle timeout default (60s)? @sre_lead fyi.

customer_acct: curl -v --no-buffer "https://api.example.com/v1/stream?model=redwood-7b" -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream'
* Connected to api.example.com (1.2.3.4) port 443 (#0)
> GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-7b HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.example.com
> Accept: text/event-stream
> Authorization: Bearer ***
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
< transfer-encoding: chunked
< connection: keep-alive
...incoming events...
* recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)
* Closing connection 0

maria_support: Nginx error log from their edge (snippet):
"2019/12/12 12:34:56 [error] 12345#0: *67890 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.0.5, server: , request: \"GET /v1/stream?model=redwood-7b HTTP/1.1\", upstream: \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/\", host: \"api.example.com\""

sre_lead: Classic proxy + idle timeout + buffer issue combo. Cloudflare (when proxied) will buffer long-running responses unless using their WebSockets/Stream feature; ALB default idle is 60s which will drop idle connections; nginx proxy_buffering can also force the upstream to complete.

dan_engineer: Quick checklist to triage:
- ask customer to temporarily turn orange-cloud off (CF bypass) and retry
- bump ALB idle timeout > 300s (or use NLB for TCP passthrough)
- in nginx set proxy_buffering off and disable proxy_cache for that route
- ensure server flushes after each SSE event and sends a comment heartbeat every ~15s (SSE comment: ":hb\n\n")
- confirm Transfer-Encoding: chunked is present and no Content-Length header

maria_support: Nginx config we suggested to them: (they will paste back)
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_pass http://upstream_app;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_set_header Connection \"\";
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
  proxy_read_timeout 360s;
}
```

customer_acct: We tried proxy_buffering off + proxy_read_timeout 300 and it improved but still disconnects ~320s. ALB idle now 300s. When we turned Cloudflare orange->gray it stopped disconnecting in our quick test.

sre_lead: That matches: Cloudflare will terminate proxied long-lived connections unless you use their Stream APIs or websocket passthrough or configure "Origin Ping"/Real-Time features. Short-term mitigation: make CF bypass or use keepalive heartbeats and ensure continuous traffic below CF buffering thresholds. Long-term: NLB in front of origin or use Cloudflare Workers + sock/proxy that supports streaming.

dan_engineer: Also check app code sending SSE: make sure after each event you explicitly flush. Example in Node/Express (res is express response):
```js
res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream');
res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache');
res.write(':hb\n\n'); // send initial heartbeat
setInterval(() => res.write(':hb\n\n'), 15000);
// after each token chunk: res.write(`data: ${chunk}\n\n`);
res.flush && res.flush();
```

maria_support: Action items: I will ask customer for full nginx conf, ALB listener settings and Cloudflare config + last 30m of access/error logs. @dan_engineer can you spin up a staging repro hitting CF + ALB + nginx chain?

dan_engineer: Yep will try to reproduce today. If we can't repro, ask customer to provide a tcpdump from just before disconnect and we can inspect RSTs.

infra-bot: deploy:staging succeeded for commit 0a1b2c3 (no change to streaming stack).

customer_acct: thanks, switching CF to gray cloud gave immediate improvement for now. We'll share logs. :thumbsup:

sre_lead: TL;DR: likely Cloudflare buffering + ALB idle + upstream not flushing. Short-term: bypass CF or increase ALB idle + disable buffering; medium-term: NLB / tcp passthrough or use CF stream/websocket support; always add heartbeat comments and flush.

maria_support: I'll update the ticket with next steps and escalate to SE if we need config assistance. Thanks everyone.
